posts.body:
Moms of Multiples is still very much active and I am involved myself. We still do bi-weekly playgroups, special coffee mornings and lunches, parties for Halloween, Xmas and Easter. Lunches at the beginning of the year (Sept) and one at the end (June). Membership fees are $350 a year (or $175 until the end of the membership year). We've also done a pregnant with multiples lunch for quite some time but all moms just delivered. However I had 2 other moms mail me (both pregnant) so with 3 or more we'll start them again ... usually on a monthly basis, so please join. You'll find the details on the website, or pm me!

HTH

thank goodness for google!

did a search: "hong kong multiples mothers" and here is the result:

posts.body:
well it pretty much follows the same schedule each year apart from different dates - there are lunches with pregnant mums, coffee mornings, playdates for under 3s, opening lunch, closing lunch, adult twin talks, all the stuff listed there. 

Plus once you join up, you are in the mailing list and get maybe one or two emails a month.

not sure what you are looking for though? If its an interactive multiple forum and you have twins, I would recommend http://twinstuff.com's amazing forum. However its mostly revolving around USA. And this geobaby forum is excellent for HK things.
